scene.ko: 9회 말 긴장된 순간에 옆자리 팬과 함께 응원하고, 날아온 파울볼을 잡은 뒤 역전승을 함께 기뻐한다.

lines.en: Bottom of the ninth, a runner on second, and we're down by one. I can't watch!
lines.ko: 9회 말, 주자 2루에 1점 지고 있어요. 못 보겠어요!

lines.en: Don't give up yet! Marco Bell is up next, right? He hit a home run in the third inning.
lines.ko: 아직 포기하지 마세요! 다음 타자가 마르코 벨이죠? 3회에 홈런 쳤잖아요.
alt: It's not over yet! Isn't Marco Bell next? He hit a homer in the third.
Don't give up! Bell is up next, right? He homered earlier.

lines.en: You're right. Wow, you've really gotten into this game!
I know! I didn't expect to enjoy it this much. Wait, was that a strike? It looked way outside to me.
lines.ko: 그러게요! 이렇게 재미있을 줄 몰랐어요. 잠깐, 저게 스트라이크예요? 제가 보기엔 한참 바깥쪽이었는데요.
alt: I know! I didn't think I'd like it this much. Wait, that was a strike? It looked outside to me.

lines.en: Come on, ump! That was way outside. Okay, two strikes now. Here comes the pitch...
lines.ko: 아, 심판! 완전히 빠졌잖아요. 좋아요, 이제 투 스트라이크. 공 들어갑니다...

lines.en: Whoa, he hit it high! Look out, it's coming this way!
lines.ko: 와, 높이 쳤어요! 조심하세요, 이쪽으로 와요!
alt: Wow, it's way up! Watch out, it's coming at us!
Whoa! Heads up, the ball is coming over here!

lines.en: Nice catch! A foul ball on your very first visit? That almost never happens!
lines.ko: 잘 잡았어요! 처음 오셨는데 파울볼을 잡다니요? 그런 일은 거의 없는데!

lines.en: I can't believe it. My hands are still shaking. Do people usually get to keep them?
lines.ko: 믿기지가 않아요. 아직도 손이 떨려요. 보통 가져가도 되는 거예요?
alt: I can't believe I caught it. My hands are shaking. Do people get to keep them?

lines.en: Of course, it's yours! Oh, look, Bell's swinging again... That's a long one... It's gone! We win!
lines.ko: 당연하죠, 이제 그쪽 거예요! 어, 보세요, 벨이 또 휘둘러요... 멀리 가요... 넘어갔어요! 우리가 이겼어요!

lines.en: What a game! Thanks for keeping me company tonight. I think I'm officially a Sharks fan now.
lines.ko: 대단한 경기네요! 오늘 밤 같이 응원해 주셔서 고마워요. 이제 정식으로 샤크스 팬이 된 것 같아요.
alt: What a game! Thanks for cheering with me tonight. I'm definitely a Sharks fan now.
Amazing game! Thank you for keeping me company. I'm a real Sharks fan now.

expressions.en: I didn't expect to ___ this much.

expressions.note: 판정 · 장면에 내 의견을 말할 때
Watch out! · Heads up! 도 같은 뜻
